tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (325)na mo gu ru dzñā na siddhi hūm̐/snang srid 'khor 'das snang stong chos rnams kyi/rang bzhin ye shes rigs bdag bla ma de/zung 'jug ye shes chen po
(325)na mo gu ru dzñā na siddhi hūm̐/snang srid 'khor 'das snang stong chos rnams kyi/rang bzhin ye shes rigs bdag bla ma de/zung 'jug ye shes chen po

tei:div.tei:p: (325)na mo gu ru dzñā na siddhi hūm̐/ snang srid 'khor 'das snang stong chos rnams kyi/ rang bzhin ye shes rigs bdag bla ma de/ zung 'jug ye shes chen po'i klong nyid las/ 'gags med rol pa sku gsung thugs yon tan/ dbyer med mnyam pa chen por sangs rgyas pa/ rang bzhin ye shes yul med mngon sum du/ rtogs pas rang snang dag pa'i bla ma nyid/ ye shes zangs thal don gyi bla mar 'dres/ 'di ltar snang ba'i brtan g.yo thams cad kun/ ma bcos rang gsal bla ma'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ sku gsung thugs mchog mi zad ye shes rol/ nges pa don gyi bla ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal/ e ma rang snang rnam dag drin can bla ma nyid/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan zag med kyi/ yon tan stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres sogs/ kun la dbang 'byor 'gro khams rgya mtsho la/ rtag tu ma g.yel thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ phrin las lhun grub dus las mi yol zhing*/ nus mthu tshad med mthong thos dran reg sogs/ phan bder (326)gnas la bde blag 'god mjad pa'i/ he ru ka dpal phyogs bcu dus bzhi na/ bzhugs pa'i rig 'jin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i skyabs gnas ji snyed pa/ 'phro dang 'du ba'i byed por mnga' dbang 'byor/ skyabs kun yon tan mkhyen brtse phrin las dang*/ nus mthur bcas pa gcig tu bsdom pa'i bdag 'khor 'das yongs la sku gsung thugs yon sogs/ rtag khyab lhun grub mi zad 'khor lor rdzogs/ rig 'jin rgyal ba ma lus thams cad las/ yon tan phrin las lhag cing thabs la mkhas/ srid zhi kun na zla bral mtshungs pa med/ ye shes sku can zung 'jug kun tu bzang*/ rgyal ba kun gyi gdul dka'i 'gro ba rnams/ rmad byung thabs mkhas phrin las lhun grub kyis/ khams dbang bsam pa de dang mtshungs pa yis/ smin grol zab mo rang rang 'bras bur bgod/ khyad par snyigs mar bod ba'i zhing 'di ru/ thugs rje'i dbang gi bsam bzhin ye shes kyi/

sgyu ma'i rol par bzhengs pa dus (327)gsum gyi/ rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i bdag nyid can/ bde gshegs sangs rgyas dag pa'i gdul byar snang*/ bdag 'dra'i las nyon gzhan dbang can gyis na/ dad pa'i yul las mngon gsum zhal mi mthong*/ tshangs pa'i gsung la nyan pa'i skal med kyang*/ de bas khyad 'phags dpal ldan bla ma yi/ bdag gi yul du mngon sum snang bar mjad/ dgyes pa'i zhal gzis brtse bas rjes bzung nas/ tshangs pa'i gsung gis zab rgyas dam chos ston/ rmad byung rdo rje theg pa 'byung dka'i chos/ bde gshegs thugs kyis gsang ba'i mjod phyes nas/ smin grol zab mos bdag sogs skal bzang rnams/ byang chub 'god pa'i phrin las zla bral ba/ yul gyi ngos nas sangs rgyas kun las lhag bdag gi snang ngor skyabs gnas thams cad las/ mkhyen brtse yon tan phrin las nus mthu rnams/ mnyam pa med cing bka' drin blal na med/ rje btsun thugs rjes ma (328)bzung bde gshegs kyis/ mngon sum gdul ba'i thabs dang bral bas na/ sangs rgyas kun las bdag la bla ma nyid/ nges par bla na med pa'i bka' drin can/ tha mal pha mas shin tu snying brtse bas/ byams skyong ji ltar byas kyang 'di snang tsam/ 'khor 'das bde skyid mtha' dag sbyin mi srid/ pha mtshog srid zhi'i bde skyid rtag par sbyin/ lhar bcas 'gro ba tha dag gnyen gyur yang*/ bla med chos kyi rgyal po 'god mi nus/ bdag nyid chen pos zag med sangs rgyas kyi/ bla med gong 'phang bde blag nyid la 'god/ srid pa gsum na thar lam ma nor ba/ ston pa'i 'jig rten skye rgur cang srid dam/ chos kyi rgyal pos bdag 'dra'i skal dman la/ thar lam tshangs la ma nor mngon sum ston/ bde gshegs rgyal bas so skye ma rung pa/ dngos su rdo rje theg par 'god dka' yang*/ dpa' bo chen pos ma rung bdag sogs rnams/ smin grol zab mos zung 'jug go 'phang sbyor/ 'jig rten 'di na skyes mchog mang na yang*/

gsang chen rdzogs chen (329)smin grol ston par dka'/ he ru ka dpal rang sems sangs rgyas nyid/ mngon sum mjal ba'i rdo rje snying po'i don/ bdag gi ma tshol bzhin du srid zhi yi/ yon tan mtha' dag mngon sum stsol mjad pa'i/ sbyin bdag chen po lan dang rnam smin la/ re ba mi mnga' phan mjad mtshungs zla bral/ bdag gi tshe rabs 'di nas byang chub bar/ srid pa'i bde skyid gya noms ji snyed pa'i/ thun mong dngos grub ma lus rje btsun gyis/ phrinalas nyid dang rjes su bzung ba'i mthus/ thun mong ma yin nges 'byung byang chub sems/ smin grol bskyed rdzogs zab rgyas sa lam gyis/ nyams rtogs yon tan zag med ji snyed pa'i/ mchog gi dngos grub thob pa rje btsun drin/ bskal pa grangs med du mar thob dka' ba'i/ byang chub chen por thabs mkhas smin grol gyi/ tshe 'dir mngon sum zung 'jug chos kyi skur/ rtsol sgrub bral bar sbyin pa mgon khyed nyid/ yon tan rgya mtsho bka' (330)drin mtshungs med pa'i/ dpal mgon nyid la byas pa bzod dka' yang*/ chos kyi dbang pa zag med chos kyi mjod/ mdo sngags bstan pa rgya mtsho ma lus kun/ bdag gi mgon po'i thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir du/ srid pa ma stong de srid stobs bskyed nas/ bshad sgrub tshul gyis 'jin cing rgyud smin tshe/ skal bzang 'gro la zab rgyas chos 'khor nyid/ bskor nas 'gro khams rgya mtsho byang chub la*/ rim gyis 'god pa'i yi dam snying la bca'/ bdag tu 'jin pa'i 'gro khams sems can rnams/ srid par stong nas byang chub ma thob bar/ phan bde mjad pa'i phrin las dam pa gang*/ bdag gi brtson 'grus stobs kyis dbang bsgyur nas/ 'gro rnams shul gnas gang 'dod srid zhi yi/ phan be ma lus bdag gi ci nus bsgrub/ mdor na 'gro mgon khyed kyis gang mjad pa'i/ rdzogs smin sbyangs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag kun/ bdag gis srid pa stong pa de bsgrub nas/

rang gzhan don gnyis snying nas rim (331)bzhin bsgrub/ bdag la deng sang 'di bzhin mngon sgrub pa'i/ shes rab brtson sogs stobs nyid zhen pas na/ stobs bcu mnga' bas rtag tu dgongs mjod la/ mthu stobs nus pa'i gzi byin bskyed du gsol/ bdag ni nam yang mthong thos dran rig sogs/ legs par sbyor dang nyes tshogs sbyor ba kun/ de dag bdag gis byang chen 'god nus pa'i/ byin rlabs stobs shugs bdag nyid chen pas stsol/ nam yang mtha' gcig gzhal la phan gyur pa'i/ lus dang longs spyod dge rtsa bcas pa rnams/ yongs su dag nas gzhan don gyur pa nyid/ dpal ldan bla mas de bzhin 'grub par mjod/ de ltar yonatan dang drin bzo rnams bsam pas sna drangs nas/ rang gzhan nyams thag gi 'gro ba rnams med snang 'khor ba sgyu ma lta bu dbang med du 'khyams pa la skyo ba dang snying shug bskyed nas yid ches kyi dad pa dang mos gus bslang*/ snying khung rus pa'i gting nas 'gro mgon bla ma nyid la (332)skyabs 'tshol bzhin gdung ba'i nga ros sngon gyis thugs dam bskul la 'dod pa'i/ de'i lam zab mo yan lag dwangs pa'i yon tan khyad par can rgyud la bskyed par gsol 'debs bya ba ni/ kye kye bla ma sku bzhi'i bdag nyid che/ 'gro ba'i mgon po mkhyen gzigs snyan gson la/ dbang med bdag sogs nyams thag 'gro ba rnams/ srid las sgrol la byang chub chen por drongs/ khyed ni chos kun dbang 'byor sgyu ma'i sku/ mtshungs zla bral ba'i yon tan mnga' bas na/ bdag sogs skyabs bral mgon med sems can la/ phan bder mjad pa'i phrin las myur du phyung*/ thog med dus nas 'gro la mtha' gcig tu/ phan par mjad pa'i thugs bskyed bla med pa'i/ 'bras bu mngon du gyur tshe dung yang*/ 'gro rnams byang chub mi 'god de ci rung*/ mgon po khyed kyis bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams/ sdug bsngal myong bzhin las nyon gzhan dab ngacan/

mgon bral nyams thag 'di la lhag par nyid/ (333)'jig rten 'di na yongs ye gzigs srid dam/ srid pa'i gnas na bdag sogs 'gro rnams la/ re ltos skyabs gyur nyid las gzhan ma mchis/ khyed kyang bdag cag dan bsgrub brtson pa la/ bdag gi don du bya ba ci zhig yod/ thog med dus nas da bar srid pa 'dir/ skye shi kha brgyud rang gzhan don ma 'grub/ sha khrag rus dang ngus pa'i mchi ma rnams/ ri dang rgya mtsho las lhag de tsam zhig myong bzhin mgon skyabs bral ba de yi tshe/ 'gro ba'i mgon khyed de tshe gang na bzhugs/ mkhyen brtse phrin las nas pa gang las byung*/ nyam thag bdag la thugs rje ma chung ngam/ chos kyi rgyal po rtag khyab lhun grub nyid/ phyogs ris bral ba'i mkhyen brtse tshad med cing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mi zad pa/ chos kun dbang 'byor dam pas min nam ci/ rtag tu bdag cag mdun du bzhugs med kyang*/ las snang log pas zhal re ma (334)mjal yang*/ bdag gis bsod nams las snang dag pa dang*/ rje btsun smon lam dag mthus rten 'brel gyis/ da lta mngon sum zhal mthong gsung thos pas/ 'di yang las smon gzhan dbang gyur pas na/ thugs rje mnga' ba rang dbang mngon gyur nas/ chos la dbang bsgyur mnga' ba don chung med/ bdag gi las snang dag tshe dgos pa chung*/ tshogs gnyis lam sbyangs byang chub thob pa nyid/ bdag mthus yin mgon pos gang zhig mjad/ nam yang las la rag las gyur na ni/ bdag nyid chen pos phrin las des ci bya/ 'di ltar bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas rnams kun/ nyid kyi mkhyen mjod bdag gi yul ma yin/ nam yang yang dag lam ston dam pa nyid/ bdag cag de sgrub 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhi/ phan bde'i gnas thob gyur pa de yi tshe/ bdag nyid chen pa'i mthu dang stobs nyid dang*/ bka' drin mtshungs zla bral bi na par nges/ nyams thag bdag sogs de (335)sngon byon pa yis/ bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs rje'i go skabs chung*/

shul du lus kyang 'gro mgon gdul byar gyur/ nyid kyi thugs rje g.yel na nam zhig thar/ bdag sogs dbang med las nyon gzhan dbang can/ nyes byas las la mi dgyes mi 'tshal te/ chos kun mnyam pa nyid du sangs rgyas par/ gzigs pa yin mod brtse bas thugs rjes dgongs/ nam zhig 'phags pa'i sa brnyes rang gzhan gyi/ don sgrub nus tshe thung chung mi dgos med/ da lta so skye las dang rkyen dbang can/ srid zhi'i khams na gdungs tshe stobs shugs bskyed/ skal bzang 'gro ba'i bsod nams gcig bsdoms pa'i/ mthu dang phyogs dus skyabs gnas ji snyed pa'i/ ye shes thugs rje gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag srid zhi'i khams na stobs chen mgon khyod nyid/ de dang mtshungs pa'i mkhyen brtse'i shug phyung la/ gang 'dul mjad pa'i phrin las ma g.yel bar/ sngon nas 'brel ba'i (336)bu rgyud smin grol la/ myur du 'god pa'i nus mthu mgon pos stsol/ tha mal pha mas bu la snying brtse bas/ nye tshe'i sdug bsngal skyobs shing phan sbyor na/ thugs rje mnga' bas rtag tu bu rnams la/ sdug bsngal las skyobs phan bder 'god rigs med/ 'phags pa'i ye shes ma mthong 'jig rten pa/ ma rungs bstan kyang gnas skabs phan brtson na/ ye shes sku can nyid kyis bdag cag rnams/ srid zhi'i phan bde'i gnas la 'god brtson rigs/ rtogs med nor bu dpag bsam shing sogs la/ gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod stsol byed na/ yon tan phun tshogs bla ma rin chen gyis/ bu yis ji ltar 'dod pa'i ro skong 'tshal/ khyad par lnga brgya tha ma'i dus snyigs pas/ bka' brgyud bstan pa shin tu nyams dma' zhing*/ dus 'dir skyes pa'i rnal 'byor yid pham tshe/ chos kyi rgyal po dus mkhyen mnga' bas na/ skal bzang snod ldan mos pa'i bu slob la/ (337)thun mong ma yin nges gsang bla med kyi/ smin grol zab mo phyir mi ldog pa yi/ chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor du gsol/

bdag nyid gcig pu'i don min rje btsun gyis/ bdag tu 'jin pa'i 'gro khams byang chub la/ 'god phyir snying nas byang chub sgrub lags na/ sngon gyi yi dam dgongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ dgongs shig mkhyen pa tshad med da dgongs shig ma g.yel thugs rje byin rlabs da ma g.yel/ ma 'chug phin las nus mthu da ma 'chug mjod cig thabs mkhas smin grol da mjod cig deng sang yang dag rtogs goms rtsal zhan pas/ kun kyang byang chub lam du tshud dka' bas/ de phyir snying nas dad gus stobs bskyed nas/ smre sngags gdung ba'i nga ros khyod gsol na/ mkhyen brtses dgongs la bdag gi spyi bo ru/ mtshan ldan phyag gi nyug bzhin byin rlobs la/ zab mo'i rtog goms bogs dbyung rtsal shugs (338)bskyed/ dbugs dbyug gzeng bstod byang chub lung kyang ston/ 'di nas mngon par byang chub snying po'i bar/ thugs rje zung la lam log lam gol sogs/ phyin ci log la ma btang thugs rje yi/ myur du yang dag byang chub lam la tshud/ tshe rabs dal 'byor snying po lon pa dang*/ rtag 'jin blos zhig 'khor bar zhen log nas/ rgyu 'bras yid ches dad dang nges 'byung blo/ bcos med snying nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas byang sems rin po che/ ma skyes skyes shing skyes pa mi nyams par/ stong nyid snying rje'i yon tan gong 'phel nas/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ srid pa'i 'jig rten stong bar de srid du/ 'khor ba 'dir gnas rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum kun/sgyu ma'i tshul gyis spyod cing rje btsun gyis/ phrin las bdag gi 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ dkyil 'khor dbang phyug he ru kaḥkhyod gyi/ bdag gi rtsa rlung thig le sems rnams la/ dbang bzhi bskur la (339)dbang don ye shes nyid/ mngon sum myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ sgo gsum zung 'jug bde chen gyis bsdom pa'i/

dam tshig dag cing grol byed zab mo yi/ 'khor ba ma spang ye shes rang snang nyid/ snang srid dag snang 'byang bar byin gyis rlobs/ nam yang chos brgyad bzang ngan snang zhen gyis/ rkyen snang byang chub grogs su 'gyur ba dang*/ nyon mongs ye shes dag cing las rnams kun/ zag med lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ zab mo ye shes lam byed thabs mchog gi rtsa thig rlung sems ye shes kyis zin nas/ sa lam yon tan thun mong ma yin pa'i/ mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs/ ka dag sems las 'das pa'i ye shes nyid/ mngon sum rtogs nas gang shar chos nyid du/ rang sar grol nas lhun grub thod rgal gyis/ snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ gal ste rnal 'byor nyams 'og ma tshud bar/ 'phos pas (340)bla mas mkha' spyod zhing drongs la/ rdo rje snying po'i dgongs spyod 'phro mthud nas/ mthar phyin zung 'jug thob par byin gyis rlobs/ mdor na nyid kyi sku dang zhing khams dang*/ 'khor dang mjad pa mtshan dang sku tshe'i tshad/ mtshungs zla bral ba de 'dra bdag sogs rnams/ myur du mngon sum 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ snang srid thams cad kun bzang bla ma nyid/ spros bral rnam par thar pa'i stong chen klong*/ 'du 'bral med pa'i bde chen ye shes dang*/ dbyer med mnyam pa chen por sangs rgyas shog maṅga lam/ (341)na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud la ji ltar 'khrungs pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa gsum skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i thugs rgyud la ji ltar mnga' ba/ nges pa'i don gyi mdo rgyud man ngag rnams kyi zab mo'i don/ brjod bya'i mthil/ kun rdzog dbang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis/ thun mongs pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul/ thun mong ma yi pa gsang sngags phyi nang gi thabs shes khyad par can rnams dang*/

khyad par theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba bla na med pa'i ka dag dang lhun grub dbyer med pa'i thugs rje rig pa'i ye shes khyad par can rnams dang*/ khyad par theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba bla na med pa'i ka dag dang lhun grub dbyer med pa'i thugs rje rig pa'i ye shes bde chen byang chub kyi saims rin po che/ rang bzhin ma bcos pa'i don/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang rig 'jin pa/ rnams kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyi mthar thug bla na med pa de nyid/ bdag dang pha ma sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la (342)da lta nyid du skye bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ 'byor pa/ rgud pa/ mtho ba/ dma' ba/ bde ba sdug pa/ na ba/ 'chi 'pho ba/ skye ba'i dus thams cad du byang chub kyi sems rnams pa gnyis mi brjed par mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ phyi nang gsang ba'i 'ag rkyen bar chad thams cad chos zab mo 'dis grogs su khyer shes pa dang*/ yang dag par lam du longs ba dang */ 'brel tshad byang chub chen por 'god pa'i byin rlabs nus mthu dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar ban rgan lung rtogs kyis gsol ba 'debs tshul lags pas bkra shis par gyur cig ༈ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas/ bral nas bdag gi rgyud la smin gyur cig bdag gi phan bde'i dge tshogs ma lus pa/ ma gyur 'gro bas thob nas sangs rgyas shog grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas su rgyal sras byang chub rdo rjes smras pa dge //
